description: DISA STIG rules for network device hardening

remediation.generic: Configure SSH to only allow version 2 connections.

rules.name: Ensure session timeout is configured for management connections

remediation.generic: Configure session timeout for all management connections.

rules.name: Ensure access control lists restrict management access

remediation.cisco_ios:
ip access-list extended MGMT-ACL
 permit ip <trusted-net> any
 deny ip any any log
line vty 0 15
 access-class MGMT-ACL in
remediation.generic: Apply ACLs to restrict management plane access to authorized networks.

rules.name: Ensure unused interfaces are administratively shutdown

remediation.generic: Administratively disable all unused network interfaces.

rules.name: Ensure syslog logging to a remote server is configured

remediation.generic: Configure remote syslog to a centralized log management server.

rules.name: Ensure NTP is configured with authentication

remediation.generic: Configure NTP with authentication to prevent time manipulation.

rules.name: Ensure login warning banner is displayed

remediation.cisco_ios:
banner login ^C
You are accessing a U.S. Government information system...
^C
remediation.generic: Configure a DoD-approved warning banner on all management interfaces.

rules.name: Ensure SNMP uses version 3 with privacy

remediation.cisco_ios:
snmp-server group SNMPV3GRP v3 priv
snmp-server user <user> SNMPV3GRP v3 auth sha <auth-key> priv aes 256 <priv-key>
remediation.generic: Configure SNMPv3 with authentication and AES-256 encryption.

rules.name: Ensure default SNMP community strings are removed

remediation.cisco_ios:
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
